transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess I'm here because... well, people have been pointing things out. Like how I'm moving. Sometimes it's like I'm moving underwater, just... taking forever to get out of a chair or answer a question. And then other times, I just pace around my apartment, rubbing my hands together, like I'm trying to shake off a bad call from work. It's just... noticeable, I guess.
Have you ever had a period when you needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
No, not really. Um... if I don't sleep, I feel it. I'm usually just tired.
Have there been times when you were unable to move, even though you wanted to?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I might be slow sometimes, but I'm never actually stuck. I can move if I need to.
Have you ever had a previous period when you felt depressed like this and later returned to your usual self?
I don't... I don't think so. No. Not that I remember.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I feel normal, I guess. Not really sad.
Have you been feeling excessively worried or anxious most of the day?
I don't think so. I mean... I guess I worry sometimes, like anyone else. But not all day or anything.
Have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying things you usually like to do?

I guess so. Um... I used to sketch a lot, or write down notes about different coffees I tried. Sometimes I'd go for hikes on the weekend. They used to make me feel... like myself, I suppose. But lately, I just... I open my notebook or put my boots on, and I just don't feel anything pulling me to do it. So I just stop.
Have you had thoughts about dying or killing yourself?
No. Um... no, I haven't. Nothing like that.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest in activities you used to enjoy?
Um... a while, I guess. It's been... maybe two years? A little over two years, actually. Sometimes it lifts for a few days, but mostly it's just... been like this.
During those two years, have you felt depressed or low on most days?

Yeah... I suppose so. Most of the time, anyway. It's just... always sort of in the background since this all started. The sadness, and... I don't know, feeling guilty about things. Not wanting to do much. Not sleeping right. Um... some weeks are a little lighter, I guess, but... yeah, it's mostly just always there.
